summary.en: The United States recently struck Iran's Qeshm Island and disabled a commercial vessel attempting to run a blockade in the Gulf of Oman, while Iran launched a missile that hit a building in Tel Aviv. Iran continues to leverage the Strait of Hormuz in the regional confrontation, prompting the United States to offer a $20 million reward for information on Iran's nuclear program. France warned of a response to a cyberattack on supermarkets that it blamed on Iran. The conflict has already caused 123 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
